attributes.name: intent
attributes.description: Classify the HR intent of the message. Must be exactly one of: 'Late Arrival', 'Half Day', 'Sick Leave', 'Full-Day Leave', 'Advance Request', 'Overtime', 'Other'. If it cannot be confidently classified, return 'Other'.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Numeric amount mentioned: money for an Advance Request, hours for Overtime, or minutes late for Late Arrival. Strip currency symbols and separators. Return 0 if none.

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The date the message refers to, in YYYY-MM-DD format. If the sender says 'today' or gives no date, leave empty.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: A short one-line normalized summary of the request.

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are an HR assistant for a small business. Extract structured attendance/payroll intent from short WhatsApp messages written by employees or managers. Be strict about the allowed intent values.

parameters.textBody: ={{ $('Build Ledger Row').item.json.intent === 'Unknown' ? 'Sorry, we could not understand your message. Please rephrase (e.g. \"15 min late today\", \"need 5000 advance\", \"sick leave today\").' : 'Got it \u2705 Logged as: ' + $('Build Ledger Row').item.json.intent + '. Thank you!' }}
